channel.title: Cabo Verde - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cabo Verde, every source cited.

item.title: Cape Verde's education system needs reform
item.description: The current system, rooted in the slave era, is insufficient for economic autonomy and national transformation.

item.title: Cape Verde agency finds non-ionizing radiation within limits
item.description: ARME measured 77 sites in Praia and found exposure levels below international health recommendations.

item.title: São Vicente opens cancer treatment centre
item.description: The new oncology unit at Hospital Baptista de Sousa aims to reduce patient travel to Santiago island.

item.title: Banco BAI Cabo Verde launches mobile bank branch
item.description: The first mobile banking unit in Cape Verde will bring services to different locations.

item.title: Woman's death ends five-year homicide-free period in Praia
item.description: Celeste Cunha, 64, was allegedly killed on October 28, ending a five-year period without gender-based violence homicides in Cape Verde's capital.
